title: The Fool and the Wise
notes: This chunk is dense and assertive: the fool is fixed as the disobedient hearer, the ten virgins are chained through prior symbols, and oil is identified as the bought-and-kept law with a sharp Gethsemane press link. Voice stays law-positive and free of AI stock vocabulary. Residual defects are almost entirely house-style sentence openings—six author sentences begin with And and one with That. One mild director cue (“Begin with”) stages the virgins section. Scripture blocks, markup, and claims are otherwise clean; no doctrine or quote wording needs touch.

proposals.old: And the Lord Himself draws the line — not between those who hear and those who don’t, but between two men who hear the very same words:
proposals.new: The Lord Himself draws the line — not between those who hear and those who don’t, but between two men who hear the very same words:
proposals.summary: Drop sentence-initial And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences starting with And. Removing it restores compliance without changing claim or density.

proposals.old: That is the whole difference between the wise and the fool.
proposals.new: This is the whole difference between the wise and the fool.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences starting with That. This keeps the same assertive close while obeying the rule.

proposals.old: Begin with who the virgins are — and who they are not.
proposals.new: Who the virgins are — and who they are not — comes first.
proposals.rationale: Presenter staging is barred. The rewrite keeps the same identification move without instructing the reader.

proposals.old: And in the law, a virgin can already belong to a husband.
proposals.new: In the law, a virgin can already belong to a husband.
proposals.summary: Drop sentence-initial And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences starting with And. Surgical removal preserves the legal claim intact.

proposals.old: And the kingdom of heaven is likened to *ten* virgins.
proposals.new: The kingdom of heaven is likened to *ten* virgins.
proposals.summary: Drop sentence-initial And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences starting with And. The count and claim remain unchanged.

proposals.old: And no one can lend it: your neighbor’s obedience will not burn for you.
proposals.new: No one can lend it: your neighbor’s obedience will not burn for you.
proposals.summary: Drop sentence-initial And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences starting with And. The non-transferability point stays sharp.

proposals.old: And it sits on the Mount of Olives (Luke 22:39) — by these symbols the mount of the olive nation: Israel itself.
proposals.new: It sits on the Mount of Olives (Luke 22:39) — by these symbols the mount of the olive nation: Israel itself.
proposals.summary: Drop sentence-initial And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences starting with And. The geographic-symbol link is unaltered.

proposals.old: And the wise were wise the way the wise man built on rock: they heard, and they did, and when the Bridegroom came their light was burning.
proposals.new: The wise were wise the way the wise man built on rock: they heard, and they did, and when the Bridegroom came their light was burning.
proposals.summary: Drop sentence-initial And in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences starting with And. The closing parallel to the rock builder remains intact.
